issue.body:
PR #36721: [xla:gpu] Improve logging by consistently adding device ordinal and ranks

Imported from GitHub PR https://github.com/openxla/xla/pull/36721

**NFC**

Follow other examples in XLA and include device ordinal and ranks in all logging related to collective operations. This helps a LOT with debugging deadlocks as it clearly shows what devices and ranks are doing.

Example:

```
gpu_cliques.cc:313] [1] [rank=1] Initialize GPU clique devices=[0,1,2,3]; is_p2p=0; root=-1; local_participants=4; incarnations=[]: local_participants=4
gpu_cliques.cc:313] [0] [rank=0] Initialize GPU clique devices=[0,1,2,3]; is_p2p=0; root=-1; local_participants=4; incarnations=[]: local_participants=4
gpu_cliques.cc:313] [2] [rank=2] Initialize GPU clique devices=[0,1,2,3]; is_p2p=0; root=-1; local_participants=4; incarnations=[]: local_participants=4
gpu_cliques.cc:313] [3] [rank=3] Initialize GPU clique devices=[0,1,2,3]; is_p2p=0; root=-1; local_participants=4; incarnations=[]: local_participants=4
gpu_cliques.cc:374] [0,1,2,3] [ranks=0,1,2,3] Create GPU communicators for clique devices=[0,1,2,3]; is_p2p=0; root=-1; local_participants=4; incarnations=[]; nroots=1; fingerprint(id)=3853589667, peer_access_enabled=1
gpu_cliques.cc:390] [0,1,2,3] [ranks=0,1,2,3] Checking clique devices=[0,1,2,3]; is_p2p=0; root=-1; local_participants=4; incarnations=[] for staleness
gpu_cliques.cc:402] [0,1,2,3] [ranks=0,1,2,3] Creating communicators for devices=[0,1,2,3]; is_p2p=0; root=-1; local_participants=4; incarnations=[]
nccl_collectives.cc:237] [0,1,2,3] ranks=[0,1,2,3] Initialize NCCL (version 2.27.7) communicators for 4 local devices (out of 4 global devices); fingerprint(id)=3853589667
nccl_collectives.cc:258] [1] [rank=1] Initialize NCCL communicator for rank 1 of 4; fingerprint(id)=3853589667; size(id)=1
nccl_collectives.cc:258] [0] [rank=0] Initialize NCCL communicator for rank 0 of 4; fingerprint(id)=3853589667; size(id)=1
nccl_collectives.cc:258] [3] [rank=3] Initialize NCCL communicator for rank 3 of 4; fingerprint(id)=3853589667; size(id)=1
nccl_collectives.cc:258] [2] [rank=2] Initialize NCCL communicator for rank 2 of 4; fingerprint(id)=3853589667; size(id)=1
nccl_communicator.h:166] [1] Created NCCL communicator NcclCommunicator(ncclComm_t=0x74f30c008430)
nccl_communicator.h:166] [3] Created NCCL communicator NcclCommunicator(ncclComm_t=0x74f308008430)
nccl_communicator.h:166] [2] Created NCCL communicator NcclCommunicator(ncclComm_t=0x74f300008430)
nccl_communicator.h:166] [0] Created NCCL communicator NcclCommunicator(ncclComm_t=0x74f310008430)
```

Device ordinals like `[0,1,2,3]` means that operation is executed collectively for all listed devices (typically inside a rendezvous callback).
